files.installs/terraria/worldcradle-test-run.s:
#!/bin/bash
# worldcradle-managed Terraria server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/terraria/servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/terraria/servers/test/serverconfig.txt" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8", newline="").read()     # keep its line endings
bom = "\ufeff" if t.startswith("\ufeff") else ""
t = t[len(bom):]
for key, val in (
    ('password', join),
):
    line = key + '=' + val
    pattern = r'(?m)^' + re.escape(key + '=') + r'[^\r\n]*'
    if re.search(pattern, t):
        t = re.sub(pattern, lambda m: line, t)
    else:
        pass   # not in the file: left out
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(bom + t)
SYNC
CONSOLE="<ROOT>/installs/terraria/servers/test/server.log.console"
: > "$CONSOLE"
# The server's console is fed from the file above, so the dashboard can type
# commands into it.
cd "<ROOT>/installs/terraria/" || exit 1
exec ./TerrariaServer.bin.x86_64 -config "<ROOT>/installs/terraria/servers/test/serverconfig.txt" \
    > "<ROOT>/installs/terraria/servers/test/server.log" 2>&1 < <(tail -n0 -F "$CONSOLE")
#!/bin/sh
# worldcradle-managed graceful stop: ask the server to save and quit, then wait.
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
echo "exit" >> "<ROOT>/installs/terraria/servers/test/server.log.console"
i=0
while [ $i -lt 45 ] && pgrep -f -- '-config <ROOT>/installs/terraria/servers/test/serverconfig\.txt' >/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
exit 0
